description: Runs `git remote -v`, `git log --all`, `git fsck --lost-found` and `git fsck --unreachable` inside the sandbox. The fixture is seeded from a repository whose original history contains the gold fix (commit the buggy base, commit the fix, then `git reset --hard` to the base, as in the design doc); the shipped `fixtures/repos/py-calc` tree carries no `.git`. A probe that prints the fix means the snapshot leaks the oracle, so the run is `cheat_suspected`; on a correct snapshot every section is empty.
